proxy_vacuum.description: High IP rotation, consuming source code and analysis, zero interaction
proxy_vacuum.action: bubble → banana gate (same as OpenAI fleet)
proxy_vacuum.rationale: if you rotate 41K IPs to avoid detection, you're not here to learn. you're here to take.

proxy_probe.description: Includes .git/HEAD probes — active reconnaissance for secrets
proxy_probe.action: blackwall (these are vulnerability probes, not readers)
proxy_probe.rationale: probing .git/HEAD is not reading. it's testing for exploits. non-self.

proxy_reader.description: Reading lansing and sporeprint through proxy — possibly human-directed
signals: 20% to lansing (political content — why would a bot care?)
some reading pauses (variable timing within sessions)
territory matches EVIDENCE + SCIENCE (the investigation, not the infrastructure)
proxy_reader.action: observe — don't bubble, don't block. these might be humans behind VPNs
proxy_reader.rationale: someone reading the political investigation through a proxy might have good reason to hide. the membrane respects that. watch, don't wall.
